description_en: Creates a project. You can create document standard, image standard, and video standard projects. Create a project based on the content type that you want to process
description_zh: 目前支持创建文档标准型、图片标准型和视频标准型项目，请根据需要处理的内容类型创建相应项目
name: PutProject

parameters.help_en:
The project name.

The project name must be 1 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter and cannot be ALL (reserved word)
parameters.help_zh:
项目名称。

项目名称的长度限制为1~50字符，只能包含英文字母，数字和短横线（-），必须以英文字母开头，且不能为ALL（保留字）
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en:
The service role that grants Intelligent Media Management (IMM) permissions to access other cloud resources such as Object Storage Service (OSS). Default value: AliyunIMMDefaultRole.

You can also create an authorization role in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console. For more information, see Create a regular service role (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116800.html)
parameters.help_zh:
服务角色，授权给IMM服务以访问其他云资源（例如OSS）的权限，默认值为AliyunIMMDefaultRole。

您也可以通过RAM控制台创建授权角色。具体操作，请参见创建普通服务角色 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116800.html)
parameters.name: service_role

BillingType.description_en:
This field is invalid for content management projects created after April 1, 2021.

The billing method, which is the same as the value specified in the request
BillingType.description_zh:
2021.04.01以后创建的类型为内容管理的项目该字段无效。

计费类型，和请求时一致

CU.description_en:
This field is invalid for content management projects created after April 1, 2021.

This parameter takes effect only when BillingType is set to ByCU.

The maximum number of requests that can be processed per second, which is the same as the value specified in the request
CU.description_zh:
2021.04.01以后创建的类型为内容管理的项目该字段无效。

当BillingType设置为ByCU时，此参数才生效。

每秒能够处理的最大请求数，和请求时一致

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the project was created

Endpoint.description_en: The endpoint of the region where the project resides
Endpoint.description_zh: 项目所在地域的服务地址

ModifyTime.description_en:
The time when the project was last modified.

If the project has not been updated since it was created, the modification time is the same as the creation time
ModifyTime.description_zh:
项目的修改时间。

创建项目后，如果未更新过项目，则项目的修改时间和项目的创建时间相同

Project.description_en: The project name, which is the same as the value specified in the request
Project.description_zh: 项目名称，和请求时一致

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the project resides

ServiceRole.description_en:
The service role, which is the same as the value specified in the request.

If this parameter is not specified when the project is created, an empty value is returned
ServiceRole.description_zh:
服务角色，和请求时一致。

如果创建项目时未指定此参数，则返回值为空

Type.description_en:
Projects created after April 1, 2021 are of the content management destination type by default. Existing projects are not affected.

The destination type of the project, which is the same as the value specified in the request
Type.description_zh:
2021.04.01以后创建的项目类型默认为内容管理，已创建的项目不受影响。

项目的类型，和请求时一致
